name: Apologizing
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of humility and reconciliation among believers, urging us to guard our speech from evil and guile while responding gently to avoid anger. Jesus teaches that unresolved conflict threatens unity, and believers are called to address offenses privately and seek restoration. When a brother sins, we are instructed to lovingly confront and forgive upon repentance, reflecting the grace and peace that uphold the body of Christ.
